title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-trade-journal-entry-notes review (PR #213)
description: Non-blocking findings from the pr-reviewer pass on PR #213 (free-text entry_notes on positions/closed trades), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's convention so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: PositionIn.entry_notes has no field_validator to strip whitespace or normalize an empty string to null, unlike PositionIn.ticker's `_strip_and_require_non_blank_ticker`. Today an explicit `entry_notes: ""` is stored/returned as `""` rather than `null`, and a whitespace-only note (e.g. `"   "`) is truthy under `if position.entry_notes:` in add_position's merge branch, so it would still get appended onto an existing note. Decide whether entry_notes should strip/normalize to null the same way ticker does, or whether free-text notes are deliberately exempt from that normalization, and record the decision either way.
